stories.label: Iran crisis — China missile deal ahead of Feb 26 Geneva talks
stories.summary: Major escalation: Reuters exclusive confirms Iran nearing deal to buy Chinese supersonic anti-ship missiles — weapons designed to sink the 30+ US warships deployed nearby. Feb 26 Geneva talks Thursday. China now actively arming Iran, fundamentally changing military calculus.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — new tariffs take effect, German auto crash
stories.summary: New Section 122 tariffs took effect at lower-than-expected rate. German car exports to China crashed 33% in 2025, showing structural decoupling beyond tariffs. Trump threatening higher duties on countries that 'play games.' FedEx lawsuit for refunds still developing.

stories.label: China-Japan export war / US chip control regime under pressure
stories.summary: Two-front story: China sanctioned 40 Japanese entities for joining US chip controls, and DeepSeek trained its latest model on banned Nvidia Blackwell chips. The export control regime that triggered the China-Japan trade war is being simultaneously retaliated against and circumvented.

stories.label: Sahel jihadist groups probing Senegal's eastern border
stories.summary: Jihadist groups expanding from Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger now threatening Senegal's eastern border. Represents spread of Sahel insurgency to West Africa's coastal states. Military juntas' expulsion of French forces created ungoverned spaces enabling expansion.

stories.label: USFK chief apologizes to South Korea after China air standoff
stories.summary: USFK commander apologized to South Korea after Feb 20 Yellow Sea air standoff with China. Reveals alliance strain from US-China competition. South Korea caught between US security alliance and China economic ties.

stories.label: Hidden human labor behind 'autonomous' humanoid robots exposed
stories.summary: MIT Technology Review reveals humanoid robot companies systematically hiding human workers who operate, guide, and correct 'autonomous' robots. Pattern mirrors self-driving safety drivers and AI content human editors.

stories.label: Iron Age mass grave reveals targeted violence against women and children
stories.summary: Nature study documents Iron Age mass grave with unprecedented evidence of targeted violence against women and children. Overturns assumption that ancient mass graves contain predominantly male warriors.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — 10,000 troops deployed after El Mencho death
stories.summary: 70+ killed in raids and retaliation. 10,000 troops deployed. Schools shut, troops on streets. Violence may be subsiding but cartel fragmentation risk remains.

stories.label: Sudan war — humanitarian crisis deepening
stories.summary: Chad border still closed. Quad ceasefire proposal on table. Needs dedicated internal humanitarian angle when fresh data emerges.

stories.label: Settlers kill Palestinian teen while Israeli soldiers watched
stories.summary: Settlers attacked Mukhmas, shot three, killed teenager. Soldiers stood by. Nearly 20 countries now condemning Israel's 'de facto annexation' drive. Pattern of military complicity accelerating.

stories.label: Israel designates 5 Palestinian news outlets as terrorist groups
stories.summary: 5 Palestinian news orgs designated terrorist groups. Criminalizes consuming, sharing, or working for outlets. Enforcement in occupied East Jerusalem.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — 4th anniversary, petal mines
stories.summary: 4th anniversary marked. Russian soldiers describe killing troops who refuse orders. Petal mines threatening civilians. No concrete new diplomatic development.

stories.label: US withdraws from NE Syria, abandoning Kurdish allies
stories.summary: US pulling out of NE Syria. Full withdrawal within a month. Turkey repatriating ISIS fighters. Kurdish SDF losing last external backer.

stories.label: ICC confirmation hearing against Duterte for drug war killings
stories.summary: ICC prosecutors say Duterte was 'pivotal' in murder of thousands. First SE Asian head of state at ICC. Drug war killed 12,000-30,000.

stories.label: Panama takes control of canal ports from Hong Kong firm
stories.summary: Supreme Court declared CK Hutchison concession unconstitutional. Government ordered occupation of Balboa and Cristobal terminals.

stories.label: France restricts US Ambassador Kushner after he ignores summons
stories.summary: France stripped Ambassador Kushner of direct ministerial access. Now demands explanation before restoring access. NATO ally downgrading US ambassador is extraordinary.

stories.label: Binance fired employees who found $1.7B sent to Iran
stories.summary: NYT reports compliance employees discovered $1.7B in crypto routed to Iran and were fired. Already paid $4.3B fine in 2023.

stories.label: IBM posts worst day in 25 years after AI threatens COBOL moat
stories.summary: IBM suffered steepest stock drop since 2000 after Anthropic showed AI can modernize COBOL. AI threatens IBM's legacy modernization monopoly.

stories.label: Deadly floods sweep Peru — 700+ districts in emergency
stories.summary: 700+ districts declared emergency. Torrential rains trigger mudslides and flooding. La Niña-driven climate event affecting over a third of municipalities.

stories.label: Kim Yo-jong promoted at rare North Korea party congress
stories.summary: Kim Yo-jong promoted to full department director at Workers' Party congress. Formalizes extensive informal power. Succession signal.

stories.label: Brazil reverses Amazon port expansion after Indigenous protests
stories.summary: Government revoked Amazon port expansion after Indigenous protests. But soy industry abandoned deforestation moratorium — pressure on the forest continues.

stories.label: Israel advances death penalty bill targeting Palestinians
stories.summary: Knesset debating death penalty bill. First execution since Eichmann (1962) would be Palestinian.

stories.label: African gig workers unknowingly trained US military AI
stories.summary: Rest of World investigation. Data labelers in Africa unknowingly worked on US military contracts through layers of subcontracting.

stories.label: Meta AI Safety Director's agent deletes her inbox
stories.summary: Meta alignment director's inbox deleted by AI agent she was testing. Illustrates agent safety problem.

stories.label: Hong Kong 47: All appeals dismissed in largest NSL trial
stories.summary: All 12 appeals dismissed. Legal architecture for permanent political control established.

stories.label: 200+ Venezuelan political prisoners on hunger strike
stories.summary: 379 granted amnesty but military-charge detainees excluded. Venezuela now inviting exiles to return.

stories.label: Netherlands installs youngest PM Jetten
stories.summary: Rob Jetten becomes youngest Dutch PM. Minority government faces uphill task after Wilders coalition collapse.

stories.label: Israeli forces detain 100+ Palestinians in Ramadan
stories.summary: 100+ detained since Ramadan began. Subsumed by broader settler violence pattern.

stories.label: Zambian communities poisoned by Copperbelt mining boom
stories.summary: Green transition mining boom causing pollution in Copperbelt.

stories.label: Pakistan warns 7.1M at risk from melting glaciers
stories.summary: 13,000 glaciers, 10,000 receding. 7.1M people vulnerable. Temps 3-5°C above normal.

stories.label: AI tools can now design entire genomes from scratch
stories.summary: AI systems architecting whole organisms. Biosecurity governance gap widening.

stories.label: ASML EUV breakthrough could yield 50% more chips by 2030
stories.summary: ASML unveils new EUV light source technology. 50% more chips from same equipment by 2030.

stories.label: Billion years missing from Earth's history — Great Unconformity solved
stories.summary: Columbia research resolves 150-year geological mystery. Shifting continents, not snowball Earths, erased a billion years of rock.
